repo=pathlib.Path.cwd(); evidence=repo/'.ufo/rounds/round-21'

expected={'executor':'@m_composer','scribe':'@m_composer','simplifier':'@m_composer','scout':'@m_grok','reviewer':'@m_grok','critic':'@m_grok','sentinel':'@m_grok','revenger':'@m_grok','mutation-tester':'@m_grok','connector':'@m_antigravity'}
for role,wanted in expected.items():
    actual=routes['effective'].get(role)
    if actual!=wanted:
        failures.append('route:'+role)
        print(f'ROUTE_BINDING: BLOCKED role={role} actual={actual} required={wanted}')
if not routes['effectiveConnectorFallbackSelectors']:
    failures.append('connector-fallback')
    print('CONNECTOR_FALLBACK: BLOCKED actual=[] required=@m_zfl')
wave=load('wave-render.json'); plan=load('wave-plan.json')
payload=json.loads(wave['stdout']); tasks=payload['taskCall']['tasks']
wave_ok=plan['exit_code']==0 and wave['exit_code']==0 and len(tasks)==32 and len({t['name'] for t in tasks})==32 and len({t['task'] for t in tasks})==32 and all(t['task'].startswith('/skill:godspeed') for t in tasks)
print(f'WAVE_SHAPE: {"PASS" if wave_ok else "FAIL"} validated_members={len(tasks)} dispatched=0')

for filename,label,expected_line in [
 ('contained-resolver-regressions.json','RESOLVER_CLI_REGRESSIONS','Ran 10 tests'),
 ('inherited-copied-cli-smoke.json','COPIED_CLI_SMOKE','COPIED_CLI_SMOKE: PASS explicit_expected_paths=0/2->2/2 controls=unchanged'),
 ('revision-comparison.json','REVISION_COMPARISON','REVISION_COMPARISON: PASS frozen=31/506->31/506 live=33/506->33/506 changed_frozen_verdicts=0 SKILL=identical PROVINCE=identical')]:
    result=load(filename); ok=result['exit_code']==0 and expected_line in (result['stdout']+result['stderr'])
    print(f'{label}: {"PASS" if ok else "FAIL"} exit={result["exit_code"]}')
    if not ok:failures.append(label)
anchor=load('committed-anchorcheck.json')
summary=next((l for l in anchor['stdout'].splitlines() if l.startswith('== ')),'')
anchor_ok=anchor['exit_code']==0 and '7 in-range cite instances, 0 bad; 7 distinct anchors; LOST-RECORDED=306 PIN-BROKEN=0 ORIGIN=0 OUTSIDE-BASE=0 BASE-ABSENT=0' in summary
print('COMMITTED_ANCHORCHECK: '+('PASS ' if anchor_ok else 'FAIL ')+summary)
if not anchor_ok:failures.append('committed-anchorcheck')
density=load('committed-density.json')
density_ok=density['exit_code']==0 and '**154.0**' in density['stdout'] and 'Total path-citation instances: 645 across 18 blocks.' in density['stdout']
print(f'DENSITY_GUARD: {"PASS" if density_ok else "FAIL"} mean=154.0 citations=645 blocks=18 exit={density["exit_code"]}')
if not density_ok:failures.append('density-guard')
resolver=load('committed-resolver.json')
resolver_ok=resolver['exit_code']==0 and 'distinct=1508 resolves=10 mirror=0 internal=125 other=0 gone=1373 skill=31/506 corpus=119/1181 all=135/1508' in resolver['stdout']
print(f'FROZEN_RESOLVER: {"PASS" if resolver_ok else "FAIL"} skill=31/506 corpus=119/1181 all=135/1508 exit={resolver["exit_code"]}')
if not resolver_ok:failures.append('frozen-resolver')
for name in ['frozen-skill-guard.json','snapshot-skill-guard.json']:
    result=load(name)
    recorded=result['exit_code']==1 and 'AssertionError' in result['stderr']
    print(f'HISTORICAL_32_506_REPLAY: {"RECORDED_FAILURE" if recorded else "MISSING_EVIDENCE"} evidence={name} exit={result["exit_code"]}')
    if not recorded:failures.append(name)
expected_hashes={'SKILL.md':'d4383dc435359aca17a3e9b5a733041300907be977fe62c6ffa48afac62fdcfc','PROVINCE.md':'206c8caaecab130fd80d75b58ed655447597b939dad79af4a30e3fa54022ad31','corpus/instruments/resolve.py':'d6a3c3f1a1d8e97d42d66a8aa3cb34530b7bc1c18b194e487ef8d580d869f903','corpus/instruments/anchorcheck.py':'c2a9e6c6088015968b3c6ea7f12a0ea66699c3ecb2a21db362659db8e95ef748','corpus/lessons/round-17-mirror-relocation.md':'195d4351992f12cf694c584a5c4357dfe603065aa95c1dda89e807e43a5e211c'}
for name,wanted in expected_hashes.items():
    ok=hashlib.sha256((repo/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==wanted
    print(f'PRESERVATION: {"PASS" if ok else "FAIL"} path={name}')
    if not ok:failures.append('preservation:'+name)
current_config=subprocess.check_output(['sha256sum',str(pathlib.Path.home()/'.omp/agent/config.yml')],text=True).split()[0]
config_ok=current_config==routes['globalConfigSha256']
print(f'GLOBAL_CONFIG_BYTES: {"UNCHANGED" if config_ok else "CHANGED"} sha256={current_config}')
if not config_ok:failures.append('global-config')
quality_present=(repo/'corpus/QUALITY.md').is_file()
print('QUALITY_BAR: '+('PRESENT' if quality_present else 'MISSING_CONFORMANCE_DEBT'))
print('OUTSIDE_SPOTCHECK: NOT_PERFORMED')
print('NATIVE_JUDGMENT: NOT_RUN; prior Phase 0 failures not replayed')
print('ADMISSION_GATE: '+('BLOCKED' if failures else 'CLEAN')+f' failed_requirements={len(failures)} verified_round_credit=0')
sys.exit(1 if failures else 0)
